children: JGBs rise in price terms in the morning Tokyo session amid possible position adjustments. Thursday's focus is likely to be on the Japanese Finance Ministry's auction of about 600 billion yen of 30-year sovereign debt. "The smaller issuance amount versus other maturities and the rise in yield to date should attract demand, particularly from real money," says SMBC Nikko Securities' Miki Den in a research report. "We expect a somewhat strong auction," the senior Japan rates strategist adds. The 30-year JGB yield is down 2.5 bps at 4.185%. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
